method: Each question draws a chord quality from the selected fixed pool and a root from MIDI 48-60 (C3-C4), keeping every root-position voicing at or below MIDI 71 (B4). Triads offer major, minor, diminished and augmented; seventh chords offer dominant, major, minor, half-diminished and diminished; mixed combines all nine qualities. Chord tones use the recorded semitone offsets from the root and sound together, low to high or high to low. Frequencies use 12-tone equal temperament with A4 = 440 Hz: frequency = 440 x 2^((MIDI - 69)/12). A question does not immediately repeat the previous quality when another choice is available. Answers match the exact chord-quality identifier; accuracy is correct answers divided by questions asked, rounded to a whole percent. The Web Audio API synthesises every tone locally with a triangle-wave envelope; there are no audio files, microphone input, storage or network requests. This practises chord-quality recognition, not absolute pitch, inversion identification, harmonic function or intonation.
